## Issue
<!-- Now feel free to write your issue, and please be as descriptive as possible! Make sure to include detailed reproduction steps. -->
<!-- Thanks again 🙌 ❤ -->
This extends FIPS compliance as done in https://github.com/lark-parser/lark/pull/1190 
hashlib.md5() is only used to get additional hash alongside with sha256, a passing of usedforsecurity=False is required. This option was introduced in Python 3.9 so we need to make sure we check whether that version is present
